resources.string: Samsung Health to Health Connect Direct Bridge

HealthBridge reads health and fitness telemetry directly from Samsung Health on your device via the Samsung Health Data SDK and writes deduplicated records directly into Android Health Connect. Zero data is transmitted to external servers, third-party clouds, or analytics services—all syncing occurs 100% locally on your phone.

1. Open Samsung Health on your device.
2. Go to Settings → About Samsung Health.
3. Tap the version number 10 times until Developer Mode unlocks.
4. Enable "Developer mode (Samsung Health Data SDK)".
5. Return here and tap Grant Access.
